snippet.title: A cozy flower garden on your desktop — BuGarden launches September 22!
snippet.description:
Hello everyone! We are Plum Tree Studio, an indie studio based in China who focus on making calming, handcrafted experiences. And this is BuGarden, our next project, which we thought you all might enjoy :)

BuGarden is a cozy flower garden that lives at the bottom of your screen. Plant seeds, add water and fertilizer, and watch your garden grow as you work, study, or hang out. If you're too busy to tend to the garden, don't worry — the little snail will help out at a slow and steady pace. As you play you'll unlock new seeds, new tools, and fun decorations for your desktop. There's also a distraction-free mode for when you want to focus!

There’s a free demo to try now, and the full game will be out in September 22th✨! 
Here’s the link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4289410/BuGarden/

Thank you very much! - Bu
